title: DLinear: No forecaster in the compared set shows a statistically significant improvement over a naive last-value predictor on Exc
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using DLinear, a decomposition linear baseline. On Exchange, at horizon 336, No forecaster in the compared set shows a statistically significant improvement over a naive last-value predictor on Exchange. DLinear MSE is within one standard deviation of persistence on the Exchange benchmark. We discuss two limitations: Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested. Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive. Future work should address reducing memory usage at input length ≥ 2048 without accuracy loss. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
